messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2;
    scanf("%d%d%d", &a1, &b1, &c1);
    scanf("%d%d%d", &a2, &b2, &c2);

    auto get_state = [](int a, int b, int c) {
        if (a == 0 && b == 0) {
            if (c == 0) return 2; // FULL
            return 0; // EMPTY
        }
        return 1; // OK
    };

    int s1 = get_state(a1, b1, c1);
    int s2 = get_state(a2, b2, c2);

    if (s1 == 0 || s2 == 0) {
        printf("0\n");
        return 0;
    }
    if (s1 == 2 || s2 == 2) {
        printf("-1\n");
        return 0;
    }

    auto det2 = [](int a, int b, int c, int d) {
        return a * d - b * c;
    };

    int d = det2(a1, b1, a2, b2);
    if (d == 0) {
        if (det2(a1, c1, a2, c2) == 0) {
            printf("-1\n");
        } else {
            printf("0\n");
        }
    } else {
        printf("1\n");
    }
    return 0;
}
